title: ReStory: Clean Every Part & Reassemble Devices
meta_description: Find the last dirty or missing part in ReStory, choose the right cleaning method and rebuild devices in the correct dependency order without wasting parts.
search_question: Why is a ReStory part still dirty, missing or impossible to place?
direct_answer_contract: Tell the player to separate dirt, damage and absence, scan every workbench view and rebuild from the deepest dependency outward.
